prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1478; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage does not match the story: the dents are on another side and at another height than the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents front-end damage consistent with a collision, though the dents sit on a different side of the vehicle and at a different height than the impact described in the claim, so the mechanism needs to be reconciled before final approval. The invoices reviewed show no repeated charges. Labor hours appear slightly high for the extent of the visible damage and should be reviewed against standard repair times. No prior damage to this vehicle is on file. Recommended plan: replace the front bumper cover, repair the left fender and headlamp bracket, and refinish the affected panels, pending a second look at the lower panel dents.
